title: THE BIBLE : THE BOOK OF OUR FATHERS | Traumatizing Knees Of Pressure!! Leviticus 26

sense.text:
The vile person shall be no more called liberal: You see that? That's why the Bishop is bringing these things out through the prophets. The vile person, this man Esau, shall no more be called what? Liberal.

Nor the churl said to be bountiful: Now notice the description the Most High gives them.

The vile person: Vile. Extremely unpleasant, foul, nasty, horrid, horrible. Morally bad, wicked. This liberal man, so-called Democrat, Republican, the Bible calls him vile. This man is wicked. And that's what's going to bring out the vileness of them. But as long as the Bible is not here, and that's why they're trying to get rid of the Bible, without the Bible the natural born killer will continue to be out there looking as a saint, looking like he's about justice and all that.

For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity: His heart will work iniquity. It's iniquity constantly in this man's mind. That's why we read the statement earlier: oh, he appeared to be under medical distress. What the hell are you talking about? It's three of y'all on this man's back, one on his neck. He appeared to be?

You're not getting justice when the people that set up an unjust system are, quote unquote, measuring out justice. That's not justice. Justice is in Revelation. Let's read justice out the Bible right now.

He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: That's the definition that we saw earlier. Equity.

He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword: That's supposed to be a knee on Derek Chauvin's neck. As a matter of fact, all these people are supposed to be in jail, because they're on stolen land.

Here is the patience and the faith of the saints: In other words, that's when justice is met. So if you ain't talking about this, you're not talking about justice.

precepts.why:
“For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee.” What did the Most High say? As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee.

“Thy reward shall return upon thine own head”: that's justice right there. That is justice right there. Okay, what do they mean, in God we trust? Just the fact that you're saying that, and then you ain't doing what the Bible says, what kind of justice are you talking about?

sense.text:
As for us: As for us, the children of Israel.

Our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: We still. Don't forget about all that. Our eyes have failed for the vain help, down through generations.

In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us: See, despite this, they still will not save us. This still cannot save us. Like you said, Bishop, maybe we look for just a little bit of hope, but it's still not going to save us.

The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits: The scripture in Lamentations 4, now read verse 20 also, because it's going along. They keep using exhale, breath and all of that. Then verse 21, it's talking about Edom. So it's ironic: it says breath there, and we're going into this being suffocated.

I also will do this unto you: Because we disobeyed God's laws. Let's keep that in our front lines. Because we broke the commandments of the Most High, that sent the judgment from the Most High against us, and this is one of the consequences of us breaking our father's commandments. I will also do this to my 12 tribes of Israel.

I will even appoint over you terror: Stop right there. Terror. That's what I want to get to now. Black people, and the Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel, are a terrorized people. We are a terrorized people. The traumatizing knees of pressure have brought a level of terror in our lives. We're the 12 tribes of Israel. Never forget that thing. Those of you that came over here through the slave trade, those of you that suffered throughout Hispaniola, suffered throughout Cuba, suffered all over the world, because the Israelites were scattered all over the planet. The Sub-Saharan slave trade and the Transatlantic slave trade, the Israelites went through that. All 12 tribes went through that thing. So you're the Israelites that the Bible speaks of.

Terror: That's what we're going to talk about now. We're going to talk about terror, we're going to talk about post trauma and how it affected us, and we're going to talk about how the Lord gave us the solution, that causes us to work together in faith, so that we can get the hell out of here. The Bible has a solution to our people's problem.

I will even appoint over you terror: Emmett Till's mother asked, was it necessary to shoot him? The answer, according to them, is yes. In other words, it was absolutely necessary for us to do all of the evil that we did to him. Why? To inflict terror. That was the purpose. Like when they dragged Byrd behind that truck in Jasper, Texas: that was to inflict terror. What are you talking about, the Bible ain't talking about us? Terror, T-E-R-R-O-R. That's terror, the root word of terrorism. So the terrorists are these people that are inflicting terror on us. We're dealing with a terrorist organization. That's the reason why they tied a 75 pound gin fan around his neck with barbed wire, to rip his body up, and threw him in the river, knowing that his body was going to come up and that the parents would see that and be forever tormented, be forever terrorized. This is what's wrong with us. A terrorized people. And they're expecting justice? No, man. We're not going to get it here. God got to bring the justice. That's the only way we're going to get the justice.

Terror: She said he was terrified. Biblical prophecy again fulfilled. The Most High said he would appoint over us terror. So she saw it in George Floyd when she walked by, spoken right out of her mouth. So you say the Bible's fiction? They know it ain't fiction.

Terror: The slaves experienced a breaking in period. Trauma is what breaks you in. They broke us in through trauma. The trauma was used to break us, and that's the reason why they do terrorist acts to us: to break our spirit, to cause fear and doubt, to break your will to want to rise up, to break your ability to want to work with your brothers, to boil you down to a slave where you'll be afraid to move, afraid to do anything. Terrorism is what did this. So when the Bible said what it said, the Lord said that because of our disobedience he will appoint unto us terror.

Terror: That's how trauma works. You brutalize, you terrorize people, and any nuance of that incident will bring terror on you. That's the reason why they drag our people and murder them and torture them, then show you the thing. Hang your sons up for you to see the dead body, the strange fruit swinging in the southern breeze, for you to smell the stench of your fathers, for you to remember that. So when these terrible things happen and they're associated with the images that we see, it stays with us, and the very memories of that bring back the trauma. So don't tell us that we need therapy. God got the therapy in the Bible. That's the reason why we as a people can't even get together. We are even afraid to organize among each other. Negroes find a reason to turn against brothers, manufacture stuff, just because they are afraid to break the mode of being terrorized. We are definitely a traumatized people, and it's passed down.

precepts.why:
When they came and got Emmett Till, they came into the house. “For death is come up into our windows”: death came up to our windows. Philando Castile rolled his window down, and death went into it.

“And is entered into our palaces”: so the people that did that to Emmett Till, they entered into the home of Mamie Till, to do what? “To cut off the children from without.” And they killed their son. This is what happens to our people, the children of Zion, the children of Israel.

“Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses.” That's the curse that happened to us.

“And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us”: confirmed by history. So what the hell do they mean, that the Bible is not true, it's not factual? Even the words in these books that we read are factual, because they're going along with the Bible. “And against our judges that judged us”: all of Israel caught hell. Our king, everybody went into captivity.

“By bringing upon us a great evil”: this is what the Most High brought upon us. Terror. “For under the whole heaven”, the whole planet, of all mankind, “hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.” So what are they talking about, some six million? This is the real holocaust here. The Bible says the worst happened to Israel. It happened to us.

sense.text:
And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow: So when we repent, brothers and sisters, the Most High is going to take that spirit of fear from us. He's going to take that sorrow from us. But a lot of us are too afraid to do that. We find excuses to get away from this re-transformation that the Most High is doing for us. The Lord shall give us rest from our sorrow: our inability to even think like men, to even plan, to construct, to build. Sorrow of mind, meaning that you have no vision, no aspirations, can't do nothing. Everything is woe is me. The Most High is going to take that away from us.

And from thy fear: He's also going to take away our fear. Fear is driven by terror. So he's going to take that away from us. He's going to punish those that afflicted us. He's going to give us rest from the fear and the terror that he put upon us for our disobedience. But when we return unto the Lord, he's going to take all that away from us. Any real man and real woman, they're going to make sure that they finish this course, because the Most High is trying to get us the hell out of here.

And from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve: Where were we made to serve this hard bondage? Right here in this captivity, all over this planet. Everywhere that we serve captivity, the Most High is going to take us out of there, and he's going to give us back our homeland.

For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob: Because we need mercy. That sister needed mercy, sitting up there, and her young self had to witness that kind of thing. We all need mercy. Let us do the right thing and let the Most High work with us, to build us up like brothers and sisters.

And will yet choose Israel: As much as we messed up with the Lord, the Lord is only asking us to return and keep his commandments and repent for our sins. And he says, when you do that, I'm going to have mercy on you, because you need mercy with all this kind of hell that we're dealing with.

And set them in their own land: We're going home, brothers and sisters. Now when I say we're going home, we ain't going home where you got the Israeli Knesset running the government over there. When we go back, it's going to be ours. None of this is our rest until the Most High brings the destruction to this whole kingdom. Then we can talk about going home.

And the strangers shall be joined with them: This is the other nations. They're going to be made to keep the commandments of the Most High, through slavery.

And they shall cleave to the house of Jacob: And they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: We're going to take our captives and bring them to their place, which is slavery.

And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord: The Israelites, the ones that God's going to have mercy on, he said that we shall possess the nations, in the kingdom.

For servants and handmaids: In the kingdom that's going to be on earth as it is in heaven, we're going to possess them.

And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were: We shall take them slaves whose slaves we were. We were their slaves. They're going to become our slaves.

And they shall rule over their oppressors: So the traumatizing knees of oppression, that's going to be ended. Who's saying this? The Most High.

The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof: So the Most High is getting ready to make some statements on this earth. He wants these words to be heard.

Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined: That's what we're doing. We're the perfection of God's beauty, but you have to be willing to go through the discipline so that you can receive this beauty.

A fire shall devour before him: The Most High is going to burn our enemies up.

And it shall be very tempestuous round about him: The Most High is bringing destruction. You can't play with the Most High. He can really clear the path for his Israelites to rule.

He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people: He's going to judge us. He's going to set us in order. That's what he's talking about. He's going to fix us up the way we need to be.

Gather my saints together unto me: The saints are the Israelites. This verse proves it. This is another precept that you're going to use to prove who the saints are. That's a command, that we as the men of God, our job is to go into these streets, wherever we go, to gather the saints of God together.

Those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice: Those are the ones that I want you to gather. So it ain't talking about gathering all nations. All nations didn't make a covenant with the Most High by sacrifice. The people that made a covenant with God by sacrifice are the children of Israel, the Israelites. That's who the law was given to.
And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: And the heavens shall declare the righteousness of the Most High.

precepts.why:
So we understand that the saints are the Israelites, because those are the ones that made a covenant with God by sacrifice. “For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people”: the Lord taketh pleasure in his saints, the Israelites. “He will beautify the meek with salvation”: he will beautify the obedient. That's what that word meek means. He will beautify the obedient with the rulership of the entire planet.

“Let the saints be joyful in glory”: let the saints be joyful in the kingdom of heaven. That's what glory is. Like when you read in Romans, to whom pertaineth the adoption and the covenants and the glory. It all belongs to the Israelites. “Let them sing aloud upon their beds”: because the Most High is going to give us rest from this captivity. That day the sorrow is going to be gone, the fear is going to be gone.

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth”: let the high praises of this Bible be in our mouths. We're going to be talking the judgments of God, and we're going to be executing that. “And a twoedged sword in their hand”: the two-edged sword in our hand is an instrument of instant obedience. Anything that goes against the words of God out of that Bible is going to be instant death.

“To execute vengeance upon the heathen”: upon the nations. Everybody that's outside of the scriptures is going to get it. “And punishments upon the people”: and the ones that don't get that sword, they're going into chains. “To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron”: that's crystal clear. Their kings and their popes, all that, they're going into fetters of iron. Iron collars around their necks, around their wrists and ankles. Slavery. Who's saying this? God. This is the kind of therapy that Darnella needs. This is the kind of redemption and mind fixing that our people need, that went through all of this trauma. This is how the trauma is going to be alleviated. Justice. Get whatever little measure you can get to make your lives a little easier, but that ain't going to compare to what you're actually supposed to get.

“To execute upon them the judgment written”: to execute upon all the nations the Bible. So you're going to find out that it's real. In that day, the Bible is going to be executed upon you. What is the judgment? He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity. That's going to be executed upon all the nations. “This honour have all his saints”: the Most High is honoring us. He's going to honor those of us that were afflicted with salvation and power.

sense.text:
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High: The secret place. This is letting you know that this place where the Most High dwells ain't in these multiple churches. The secret place of the Most High is his commandments. These churches ain't teaching you that.

Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty: We're protected when we keep God's commandments.

I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust: We trust in the Most High. We ain't trusting in your justice system. We ain't trusting in nothing that you got laid out here. We obey the laws and all that, but our trust goes to the Lord. That's the point. Our trust goes to the Most High.

Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler: Surely he will deliver us from our oppressors, from the trauma. They're trying to destroy all of us, with abortions and all types of things. The Most High is going to deliver us from that. It's not an accident that you're still here. You're not still on this earth because of the mercy of the so-called white man. You're here because of God. He shall deliver us from the traps.

And from the noisome pestilence: From the sicknesses and the diseases. He's going to deliver us from all of that.

He shall cover thee with his feathers: He shall cover us with his protection and his commandments.

And under his wings shalt thou trust: And under his commandments shall we trust. That's what he's talking about.

His truth shall be thy shield and buckler: His commandments. His truth shall be our shield and buckler, because the wages of sin is death. He that keeps these commandments will have everlasting life. So we're going to be all right, brothers and sisters. Even if they kill us physically in the body, all I got to do is stay in this. I'm good.

Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night: Thou shalt not be afraid of what? The terror by night. So we ain't afraid of the knees. We ain't afraid of all of that stuff. But I know our people are, because they've been traumatized with all the stuff that happened, with Emmett Till.

Nor for the arrow that flieth by day: That arrow is the weapons of God. The missiles. The Most High caused the missiles to be made, because that's going to be the weapon that's going to be fired, so that he's going to deliver his Israelite people.

Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness: The sicknesses and diseases. We're worrying about that COVID-19.

Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday: We're not worrying about the destruction that wasteth at noonday. That's the bombs that the Most High is going to bring.

A thousand shall fall at thy side: When them bombs hit, a thousand of our enemies are going to fall at our side. Many people dying all at once. That's going to be the deliverance. That's going to be the beautifying the meek with salvation.

And ten thousand at thy right hand: And ten thousand of our enemies are going to fall at our right hand. That's why the Bible says, and their enemies beheld them when they were taken up. That's the same incident.

But it shall not come nigh thee: The destruction shall not come nigh, because we're going to be getting beamed up.

Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked: So after we've been seeing trauma with our own eyes, the Most High is going to give you some therapy that you're going to see with your eyes: to see your enemies get destroyed. That's going to be instant relief, instant healing, instant therapy.
There shall no evil befall thee: Therefore no evil shall befall us.

precepts.why:
Some people say, oh, the white man gave y'all some liberties, and that's the reason why we're still here. The reason why we're still here is because of God. “It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed.” That's who's in charge of that thing.

“Because his compassions fail not”: God's compassion, not the so-called white man's compassion. Because God's compassions fail not, that's the reason why you're still here: so that you can get this knowledge, you can get this word, you can get this salvation that the Most High is offering you, and you can come the hell out of here.
